nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build context exclusion rules that omit virtual environments, Git metadata, Python caches, and tabular spreadsheet files from the image context.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Defines a single-stage container image for the Streamlit churn application using the uv Python 3.13 Bookworm slim image, a locked production environment, bundled application assets, and port 8501.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses uv sync with --locked, --no-dev, and the mitra extra before launching Streamlit from the project virtual environment.

nodes.name: uv
nodes.summary: Container build stage based on ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.13-bookworm-slim and exposing the Streamlit service on port 8501.
